summary: Frontend-only re-verification of scanner visibility bug fix in /app/frontend/app/scan.tsx. Login (abdul/Salam@123) succeeded. SEARCH -> Scan renders the camera area with targeting bracket + Gujarati hint 'Part number barcode/QR camera સામે રાખો' and no blank box. Manual part entry '39100-2B000' + 'SEARCH — Continue' navigated to /part/39100-2B000 which shows KNOWN PART detail (name, company, category, in-stock). BUY mode ('/scan?mode=buy&company=All') and REQUIREMENT mode ('/scan?mode=requirement&company=All') also render the same camera scanner area with the bracket + hint and their correspondingly labeled Continue button ('BUY — Continue', 'REQUIREMENT — Continue'). Scanner bug fix is fully verified across search/buy/requirement modes. One non-blocking console warning noted: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' (from the overlay View in scan.tsx line 118).

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecation warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Reference: /app/frontend/app/scan.tsx:118 (pointerEvents="none" prop). Non-blocking but should be migrated to style.pointerEvents.

action_items: Optional (non-blocking): In /app/frontend/app/scan.tsx line 118, move pointerEvents="none" from prop to style (style={{pointerEvents:'none'}} or in the styles.overlay object) to silence the RN deprecation warning.
critical_code_review_comments: scan.tsx correctly auto-requests camera permission on mount, has a 3-state renderCameraArea (loading / denied / granted), and cameraWrap has minHeight:300 so the scanner never collapses to a blank box on web — matches the described fix.

CameraView is now rendered on web as well; in a headless browser without a camera it shows a solid placeholder (green in our screenshots) but the overlay bracket + hint are on top, so the screen is never visually empty. Acceptable per review request.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Scanner visibility fix is verified for SEARCH, BUY, and REQUIREMENT. Manual entry navigation confirmed working: /scan?mode=search + '39100-2B000' + Continue -> /part/39100-2B000 (KNOWN PART detail loaded from backend). Use testIDs: login-username, login-password, login-submit, module-search/buy/sell/requirement, manual-part-input, scan-continue.
rca_of_issue: Original bug: Camera not shown in SEARCH due to (a) permission not auto-requested (blank undetermined state), (b) CameraView disabled on web, (c) no minHeight on camera wrapper. Fix in scan.tsx: useEffect auto-calls requestPermission when !granted && canAskAgain; renderCameraArea now returns a visible fallback for the loading and denied states; CameraView renders on both native and web; styles.cameraWrap has minHeight:300. Verified end-to-end via UI.
